 Chyi Chin, Raymond Lam & Michael Wong head to Singapore for year-end 'Sands Live Season' concert programme
 SPINS 
 2.3K 
 Estimated:   reading 
 Words by Hidzir Junaini 
 First published: 16 November 2026 
 Last updated: 16 November 2026 
 News 
 Gigs 
 Events 
 Marina Bay Sands is closing out 2026 and welcoming the new year with four concerts featuring some of Mandopop and Cantopop's most celebrated voices.
 The sixth edition of Sands Live Season will bring Chyi Chin (齐秦) , Raymond Lam (林峯) , and Michael Wong (王光良) to Singapore for a series of performances from 27 December 2026 to 2 January 2027 at the Sands Grand Ballroom, Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre .
 Spanning nostalgic Mandopop classics, heartfelt ballads, and high-energy Cantopop performances, the festive concert series promises a varied musical programme as fans bid farewell to 2026 and usher in 2027.
 Kicking off the celebrations on 27 December , Taiwanese singer-songwriter Chyi Chin will return to the solo stage with ‘BELONG TO US’: CHYI CHIN LIVE 2026 . Accompanied by an all-new band, the Mandopop veteran will revisit his extensive catalogue through refreshed musical arrangements, bringing new interpretations to some of his most recognisable songs.
 Fans can look forward to classics including ‘Wolf’ (狼) , ‘Somewhere in Winter’ (大约在冬季) , and ‘The Outer World’ (外面的世界) , songs that have helped establish his enduring influence on Chinese-language pop music.
 Taking over on 30 and 31 December , Hong Kong singer and actor Raymond Lam will bring his ‘GO WITH THE FLOW’ World Tour to Singapore for two consecutive nights.
 Known for his ability to move between emotive ballads and upbeat Cantopop hits, Lam will present a setlist accompanied by elaborate stage transformations, offering fans an energetic way to close out the year.
 Since embarking on his music career in 2007, Lam has built a devoted following with songs such as ‘Finding Love in Memories’ (爱在记忆中找你) and ‘Love With No Regrets’ (爱不疚) . The latter was famously featured in the hit television drama Moonlight Resonance , in which he also starred.
 Beyond his music, Lam has enjoyed an extensive acting career, appearing in popular productions including Line Walker and the acclaimed martial arts film Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In .
 Rounding out the festive concert series on 2 January 2027 , Malaysian singer-songwriter Michael Wong will bring his ‘NEVER APART, LONELY PLANET 3.0+’ World Tour to Singapore.
 Celebrating more than three decades in music, the beloved Mandopop balladeer will revisit songs that have become staples of Chinese-language pop, including ‘Fairy Tale’ (童话) , ‘First Time’ (第一次) , ‘Right Hand Side’ (右手边) , and ‘Courage’ (勇气) .
 Known for his tender vocals and heartfelt songwriting, Wong's concert promises an evening of nostalgia, revisiting the love songs that have accompanied generations of listeners.
 Now in its sixth edition, Sands Live Season continues Marina Bay Sands' longstanding concert programming, which began with the original Sands Live series in 2014.
 Over the years, the series has welcomed international stars including The Rolling Stones , Michael Bublé , Aaron Kwok , and Celine Dion . Since the introduction of Sands Live Season in 2023, it has also featured sold-out performances by George Lam , Sally Yeh , Joey Yung , Hacken Lee , Leo Ku , David Tao , A-Lin , Zhao Chuan , PSY , and RAIN .
 Tickets for all four upcoming concerts are now on sale, with prices ranging from S$98 to S$258, excluding booking fees. Each performance will begin at 8PM.
 Ticket categories are priced at S$258 for VIP, S$228 for A Reserve, S$188 for B Reserve, S$148 for C Reserve, and S$98 for C Reserve restricted-view seats.
 For more information and ticketing details, visit the official Sands Live Season website .
